_head: Phase 1's measurements, replayable. Boxes are design pt at capture scale 3 (1179x2556 for 393x852); run with --pt 3. --against wants a directory of renders shot at --scale 3 --crop-phone and resized to 1179x2556, which is what scratch/pipe.py all writes to scratch/mine; every probe names its own file there. The status bar is the template's, not the capture's, so no probe sits above y 54; the nav row starts at 70. All seven captures are one Mobbin harvest of the same device, so a colour measured on one screen is quoted for all seven. On a sample, 'bright' takes the brightest percentile as the ink core (white type on the pink pill); on a bbox, --bright is the luminance above which a pixel counts as ink (a white key cap on the keyboard's grey). A chip's fill is #F3F0F3 against a #FDFBFC page, so a chip box is found with --dark 246 -- ten levels of separation, which is why no chip here is measured by eye. batch swallows 'axis' for anything but a scan, so a bands probe cannot ask for columns: where a column grid had to be checked (the stat columns, both tab rows) it is one bbox per column, windowed on the midpoints between the centres.
